name: Absol
note: Walk into the shaking patch. Absol appears in no other encounter table in the game.

name: Lapras
note: On the ice lake. The only water in the game that holds one.

name: Swablu
note: On the rooftop — it drops on you rather than appearing in grass.

name: Skarmory
note: Two mountain tables carry Skarmory in the grass; this is the one you can reach.

name: Kingdra
note: Surf onto the whirlpool on Marfeny Lake. It also shows on the lake’s DexNav list.

name: Charmander
note: Walk into the shaking patch on Route 412.

name: Cyndaquil
note: Walk into a dust cloud inside Mt. Shuem.

name: Zoroark
note: Its Illusion ability disguises it as another Pokémon, so it won't look like Zoroark until the battle starts.

name: Mudkip
note: Surf on Route 412 and move onto the rippling water.
